title: A Path Integral Model of Cognition
summary: We develop the mathematical and physical formulation of cognitive cost optimization that underlies the path-integral model of consciousness. The goal-directed cognitive process is modeled as imaginary-time evolution (ITE) under a projector Hamiltonian that rewards configurations consistent with a target concept. We establish three results. First, this ITE coincides with a double-bracket flow and is therefore the Riemannian gradient flow of a Hilbert--Schmidt cost whose unique minimum is the solution.
